name: Best-returner event study
description: Each year, the #1 and top 5 total returns inside the point-in-time S&P 500 at that year-end, and the return of those same stocks the next year.
notes: 74 removed tickers had no Yahoo/Stooq prints during a membership spell (often a recycled symbol, or a delisted name Yahoo no longer stores): ABI, ABX, ACV, ADCT, ADT, AM, APC, ASO, …
Stooq returned a browser check, so it filled no delisted names.

distribution.note: Finished next years only. Excluded drops a missing next return. Worst fills it with -100%. Neutral fills it with that next year's SPY total return. Hit rate is the share of observations that beat SPY. A next-year print above +1000% is unverified and is left out of all three.
